A.session_notes: Two changes, both REP cuts at the same weight: leg press and shoulder press go 10 -> 8. Load protects muscle in a deficit, the last 2 grinding reps only cost recovery. Bench HOLDS at 70 - RPE 10 twice means that is your ceiling this month, and holding it during a cut is a good session, not a stall. Cable crunch is gone: hanging knee raise replaces it. Curl the pelvis up toward your ribs, do NOT just lift the knees - knees-only makes it a hip flexor exercise, which is backwards for anterior pelvic tilt. Straight bar (your call, for the grip work), and end the set when you start swinging, not when grip fails - a kipping rep loads the lower back and defeats the whole point.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press
exercises.notes: HOLD 70. RPE 10 on both 08-09 and 08-17 with all reps complete = at ceiling. Do not add. Retention is the goal, not a PR.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Was 3x10 @17.5 at RPE 9. Same weight, 2 fewer reps. Should land at RPE 8.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45
exercises.notes: Biggest change of the day. Was 3x10 @145 at RPE 9 - highest tonnage in the session and it is the twice-operated knee. Tonnage drops 4350 -> 3480 kg. Partial ROM, knee-friendly depth.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Unchanged. RPE 9 here costs you almost nothing systemically at 7.5 kg, so it is not worth trimming.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.notes: NEW - replaces Cable Crunch. Hanging puts the spine in traction instead of compression. FORM: curl the pelvis toward the ribs, slight lower-back rounding at the top is correct. Knees-only = hip flexors = counterproductive. Straight bar for the grip work. STOP the set when swinging starts, not when grip fails. Grip-limited reps are fine.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl (superset A)
exercises.notes: Straight into the wrist curl, no rest. Supersets run high on RPE by design - leaving this alone.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl (superset B)
exercises.notes: Second half of the pair. Rest 60s after this, then back to the reverse curl.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest between drops: 45 to failure -> 40 to failure -> 35 to failure. RPE 10 here is the design, not a problem. Chest finisher - loads the pec stretch that flat bench underworks.

B.session_notes: Biggest rework of the three days, all of it aimed at the back. RDL is PARKED for 3-4 weeks - hip thrust replaces it, starting deliberately light at 40 kg to learn the pattern. Shoulder blades on a bench, chin tucked, squeeze the glutes and STOP AT NEUTRAL - never arch past straight at the top. If 40 kg lands under RPE 7, go up 10-20 kg next time. Cable crunch is out, suitcase carry is in: 2 x 40 m per side, one dumbbell in one hand, stand tall, ribs down, do NOT lean away from the weight. Carries are the one intervention your own history says actually helped. Pull-ups cut to 3 sets - this is the exercise your back pinched on. Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch, no negotiating.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: NEW - replaces the parked RDL. The program had ZERO direct glute work across all 30 logged sessions. 40 kg is a deliberate learn-the-pattern load, not a strength target - if it comes in under RPE 7, add 10-20 kg next session. FORM: shoulder blades on bench, chin tucked, squeeze glutes, STOP AT NEUTRAL. Never arch past straight.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip
exercises.notes: Cut from 4 sets to 3. This is what your back pinched on 08-21. Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch - do not try to finish it.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: Was 3x12 @22.5 at RPE 10. Same weight, 2 fewer reps. You gained +2.5 kg here this cycle, so hold the load and give back the grinding reps.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Hold. RPE 9 last time with all reps complete.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: This is a posture and shoulder-health movement - it should feel like RPE 7-8, not the 9 you logged. If 40 does not feel easy, drop to 35. Nothing is gained by grinding this one.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: NEW - replaces Cable Crunch. 40 METRES per side, not reps. Anti-lateral-flexion under load with near-zero spinal shear, plus grip and trap carryover. Your profile says weighted carries previously helped the back - they had been absent from the program entirely. FORM: one dumbbell, one hand, stand tall, ribs down, do not lean away from the weight. 2 sets only - that is ~5 min, same as the cable crunch it replaces.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest between drops: 35 to failure -> 30 to failure -> 25 to failure. Starting at 35 because you did 3x10 at 35 as straight sets on 08-21.

C.session_notes: Your best-calibrated day - you logged RPE 7/7/8/7 here, which is exactly the target band, so this is the day that earns progressions. Four of them: box squat 55, cable row 52.5, lat pulldown 42.5, hammer curl 15. All four were all-reps-complete at RPE 7-8, which is the rule for adding load. Two things do NOT move: incline bench holds at 22.5 (RPE 9), and Bulgarian split squat drops to 8 reps at the same weight (it came back RPE 10, the only outlier on this day).

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: Hold. RPE 9 last time. Real improvement already banked - you went from 12/9/8 with a drop-off to a clean 10/10/10 at full weight.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.notes: +2.5 kg. Earned: 3x10 @52.5 at RPE 7. High box, limited depth, knee-safe. If the knee says anything at all, stop the set.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.notes: +2.5 kg. Earned: 3x10 @50 at RPE 8.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Rep cut, same weight. Came back RPE 10 - the only outlier on an otherwise well-calibrated day. Should land at RPE 8 now.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: +2.5 kg. Earned: 3x10 @40 at RPE 7. This one regressed earlier in the cut, so getting it moving again is worth noting.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: +2.5 kg. Earned: 3x10 @12.5 at RPE 7. Neutral grip, brachialis bias.

exercises.name: Lying Incline Dumbbell Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop per hand, no rest between drops: 10 to failure -> 7.5 to failure -> 5 to failure. The only stretch-position bicep movement in the whole program. FORM: bench at 45-60 degrees, upper arms hanging BEHIND the torso and kept still, no rolling the shoulder forward to cheat the rep.
